podcast.body: Released in 1980, this track is considered the very first East Coast hardcore release. By the time it came out, Bad Brains had evolved from a jazz fusion group, Mind Power, to a hardcore band with blistering tempos, inspired by the Ramones' song "Bad Brain." "This track is probably the very first East Coast hardcore release. It's called Heat Come. Bad Brains. Or the Bad Brains, take your pick. From 1980, tremendously influential to punk kids in the DC area."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
